Rockets embed into targets, spewing three Napalm Pools every 0.75 seconds until detonation. Napalm Pools rapidly apply <solar/>40 Scorch (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 5 seconds.

Gain one stack of 'Composite Propellant' every 6 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Firing this weapon triggers a 3 second cooldown on passive stack generation.

Composite Propellant benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.5|2.25|3|3.75|4.5 second delay before detonation
• 3|6|9|12|15 released incendiary pools
• 0%|7%|14%|21%|29% increased detonation damage

At 5 stacks of Composite Propellant, rockets leave a trail of Napalm behind them, applying <solar/>50 Scorch (70 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 2 seconds.
